description: This file defines the ClientEntity class implementing the ClientEntityInterface for OAuth2 clients, modeling client-related data such as ID, name, redirect URI, confidentiality, and display name, with a factory method to create instances from OAuthClient entity objects.

classes.name: ClientEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 client entity in the system, implementing required interface methods and a factory method for instantiation from OAuthClient data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of ClientEntity with specified client data.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the client.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the client.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI associated with the client.

methods.name: isConfidential
methods.description: Indicates whether the client is confidential.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the client.

methods.name: createFromEntity
methods.description: Static factory method to create a ClientEntity instance from an OAuthClient entity.
